sloka: यावत्करस्थः शूलो ऽयं भविष्यति सुतस्य ते ।अवध्यः सर्वभूतानां शूलहस्तो भविष्यति ।। ७.६१.१५ ॥
transliteration: yāvatkarasthaḥ śūlo 'yaṁ bhaviṣyati sutasya te ।avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ śūlahasto bhaviṣyati ।। 7.61.15 ॥

translations.english: As long as this trident remains in your son's hand, he will be invincible to all beings, being one who wields the trident.
